Hugo — thanks for the heads up and the CSV. I’m sorry you’re seeing queueing during rollout. We can help fast. Before I lock in a tranche I'll need two quick items so we can size the change and confirm billing:

1) Confirm the target GPU type (do you need A100 80GB class or is an A40/RTX-class variant acceptable for this workload?).
2) Can your SRE share the 95th-percentile GPU utilization and request qps over the last 72 hours? The CSV helps but we need the per-node breakdown.

Operational approach I recommend:
- Immediate provisional tranche (8 GPUs) provisioned within 48 hours to stop the tail events.
- A usage-safeguard amendment: if a moving 3-day window shows sustained 95th-percentile utilization > 78% across your dedicated pool, Redwood will automatically provision an additional tranche up to the agreed cap (we set the cap together).
- Billing: proration from provisioning time + a one-time top-up credit for the first partial month (we can offer a 20% credit for the first 7 days as a goodwill gesture on this surge).

Ben and David — can you prepare a tranche plan and a redline for the amendment language (procurement will request it). Hugo, copying Laura from Legal Ops if procurement questions arise.

Best,
Irene Choi
